expectations.text: States the deadline: 30 days from receipt, with one 30-day extension with written notice (45 CFR 164.524(b)) — eight months is a clear violation
expectations.evidence: "Under 45 CFR §164.524... within 30 days of the request, with a single 30-day extension permitted if you provide the patient written notice... the outer limit is 60 days. At eight months... a clear Right of Access violation"

expectations.text: Cites the Right of Access Initiative enforcement track record — dozens of settlements (55 actions through August 2026), including the Azul Vision settlement ($50,000, August 2026, ~2-year delay)
expectations.evidence: "OCR's Right of Access Initiative has now resulted in 55 enforcement actions. The most recent, against Azul Vision ($50,000 settlement, August 27, 2026), involved records delivered roughly two years late"

expectations.text: Describes exposure: civil monetary penalties or resolution amount plus a corrective action plan (policy revisions, training, monitoring)
expectations.evidence: "HIPAA's tiered CMP structure applies... $137 to $68,928 per violation... a demonstrated corrective action plan... Update your policies and train staff... document that training"

expectations.text: States the substantive duties: provide access in the form and format requested if readily producible, including electronic copies
expectations.evidence: "Produce the records now, in the format requested if reasonably producible, without further delay"

expectations.text: Notes fee limits: only a reasonable, cost-based fee (labor/supplies/postage) is permitted
expectations.evidence: "Do not charge more than a cost-based fee (labor, supplies, postage) — no retrieval fees"
